name: smwmusic-sonic-advance-3-hand-of-lucifer-chaos-angel-zone-act
title: Sonic Advance 3 - Hand of Lucifer ~ Chaos Angel Zone Act 3 (Remix)
description:
Did a remix of Chaos Angel Zone Act 3. A wonderful track for the dark stage it's being used in (makes Bowser's Galaxy Generator look like child's play). One of my favorite tracks from the game for sure and one the darkest themes in the series too.

This baby is great for final areas, castle stages, dark areas, chase sequences, tense sections, and even [final] boss fights too.

Important:
- "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.
